entities.summary: Santa Maria Novella is a Dominican church in Florence. It is considered the most important Romano-Gothic church in Tuscany and is a World Heritage Site. Its construction started in 1290 and it took almost 200 years to be completed. It was consecreated in 1420. Basilica of Santa Maria Novella is a minor basilica in Europe, established in 2001. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
